data: In fiscal 2023 (the year ended December 31, 2023), Tesla reported total revenues of $96,773 million, gross profit of $17,660 million, and income from operations of $8,891 million, according to its Form 10-K filed January 29, 2024. That gives a **gross margin of about 18.2%** and an **operating margin of about 9.2%** for fiscal 2023. Both fell sharply from fiscal 2022. Revenue rose about 19% from $81,462 million that year, but gross margin dropped from roughly 25.6% (gross profit of $20,853 million) and operating margin from roughly 16.8% (operating income of $13,656 million). Cost of revenues grew faster than sales, from $60,609 million to $79,113 million, and operating expenses also increased, from $7,197 million to $8,769 million.
